title: I can't stand watching this anymore.
paragraphs: “Bubhee! Buhee!”
“You dare to fear my power—the power I gained by inheriting that of Raildia, whom the Spear Hero killed? This is the true representative and president of Shieldfreeden! I mean…”
Father, while tending to the queen’s wounds, repeated the words so I could understand.
“I’m here to avenge Raildia, who was brutally murdered by you lot! Suffer!”
At this point, Rival began radiating an exceptionally intense killing intent.
“Huh? Are you underestimating me? Do you even realize how much trouble your corruption has caused Gaelion? Save your jokes for your faces and the way you live your lives!”
“Hah! What are you getting so worked up about? You’re such a child! If you’re going to lead a country, you’ve got to act like an adult!”
Takt seized the moment to provoke Rival. It’s true—Rival really is childish.

“You’re all a bunch of low-IQ Trash, yet you act so high and mighty! You guys! You’ve made us miserable! So die! Your deaths will give us a sense of relief, and this world will become a better place!”

“What a load of nonsense! You’re the one who’s been killing the Seven Star Heroes one by one, covering it up, and forcing the innocent people of Shieldfreeden into slave-like hard labor—all while pretending to be some kind of inventor—and now your evil deeds have finally been exposed!”
Father is completely fired up as he snaps back at Takt. Those were some pretty heartfelt words. After all, these are all the atrocities Takt has committed against the people of Shieldfreeden.
“It’s survival of the fittest out there! If you win, no matter what means you use, you’re the boss! Don’t you get it?　You probably don’t. You guys are just childish!”

“Are you really going to use that ‘winning is everything’ argument here? Well, since you lost to Motoyasu, you’d better accept it. And if we’re childish, Takt, then you’re a barbarian! You’re the one who thinks of nothing but killing anyone you don’t like!”
“Say whatever you want! You guys should just be afraid of my power! Look at this sword! And I’ve got more where that came from!”
Takt is proudly showing off not just his sword, but also an axe and a throwing weapon. It seems he gathered them while he was operating undercover.

“Don’t underestimate my power! I… can accumulate the power of every Hero’s weapon I’ve ever held and use it to strengthen my own weapons! I’m in a whole different league from you guys, who only have one weapon each! This time, I’m going to turn you all into a pile of ashes!”
How should I handle this situation? I’d like to kill them as gruesomely as possible, but…
Just then, the wall was smashed open with a loud crash.
“What the—!?”
To our surprise, Zou and Kou burst in.
“Hah!”
“Whoa—!”
“We’ve finished evacuating the other hostages… but…”
Zou and Kou scanned the area and seemed to realize this wasn’t the time for that.
“Ugh… Reinforcements? And it’s Zou—that blockhead! We don’t need trash like you here! Get lost!”
Zou is looking at Panda with a “What is this guy?” expression, seeking an explanation with his eyes. After catching that look, Panda said with an exasperated tone,
“Apparently, this is Takt—the guy that the Spear Hero was supposed to have killed. He transferred his soul into a homunculus body and made a grand comeback.”
“Ah… I see. He’s quite the arrogant brat who’s gotten way too big for his britches. Kou, you go over to the Shield Hero and the others and protect them.”
“Got it!”
Kou moves quickly to get near us and takes up a defensive stance.
“What did you say! Don’t you dare act all tough for a lowly nobody like you!　As for me! I’ve been storing up power by using multiple Hero’s Weapons—I’ve gotten way stronger!”
Takt is furious after hearing Zou’s comment. He’s the type whose boiling point is impossible to predict.
“Come to think of it, you guys were the Heroes’ aides! And now you’re acting all high and mighty just because you’ve gotten a little stronger!”
“Oh my, you seem quite the master of self-introduction, don’t you? You’re nothing but a kid in every other way, but with that one ability, you could take on the world, couldn’t you?”
“What did you say!?”
Hearing Zou’s provocation—as she’s fully entered “Queen of the Earthquake” mode—Takt’s expression darkens with even more rage than before. His gaze is fixed firmly on Zou.
“He’s the one who wronged us all! I’ll make that shield-and-spear guy taste what I’m feeling! Everyone! Let’s start with this annoying guy first!”
“‘Oink!’”
“King Aultcray, Princess Melty… Excuse me. Lord Iwatani, please protect Her Majesty the Queen, the King, and the Princess.”
Éclair stands up, radiating a murderous aura, and heads toward the panda and the elephant.
“It’ll be fine, Éclair. Could you and Lars-chan buy us a little time?”

“Lord Iwatani, I thank you… I don’t know if I can buy much time, but I’d like to try. The crime of harming Her Majesty the Queen, and those words and actions—I cannot forgive them, either publicly or privately. I swear I will make him pay with his own life!”
Saying that, Éclair went over to the elephant and the panda.

“Whoa, can’t you see this? Spear—you know what’s at stake if you don’t want this broken, right? Do your job properly, you spear guy. If you go easy on the shield like you did before, every egg in the world’s gonna crack!”
Takt is trying to blackmail me using Filolial-sama’s egg as leverage.
“Ugh… That’s a cheap move!”
Filolial-sama is completely innocent! Takt! Why are you using Filolial-sama as a shield when it’s your own misdeeds we’re talking about?!

My blood is boiling, and yet my murderous intent is still surging. I can feel a new curse being unleashed from my spear with a crackling sensation, but I have a promise with Filo-tan. I absolutely will not let the power of a curse stain my hands!

“Hahahaha! I’ve been dying to see that look on your face! How long are you going to keep treating that thing?! There’s no way she’s going to make it! Granny who abandoned her own daughter deserves to die! I went to all that trouble to set things up so you’d be easy to fight, and yet you go and pull this half-assed stunt!”
“Youuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuu!”
Trash is shooting a murderous glare at Takt. But Takt just looks like he couldn’t care less.
Either way, Takt intends to make the most of Filolial-sama’s egg and exploit my loyalty to run amok. Ugh… my stomach’s so full of holes, blood’s…
“…I’ve had enough. Gaelion, I just can’t watch this anymore.”

Just as Rival said that in a tone that could be interpreted as either anger or calm, he began casting a Magic spell unlike anything I’ve ever seen in this world. His initial target appears to be the pig in the white coat. It also looks like the magic circles reveal his other targets.
“O all collaborators of Gaelion. Obey Gaelion’s call and manifest yourselves, drawing strength from the power of evil.”
“B, Bbuhi!? Buhi!”
“Bbubu!”
The Aotatsu Pig and some pig that looks like a wizard are making all sorts of noises.
“Huh? Are you okay with whatever happens to this egg? The Spear Hero isn’t going to take this lying down!”
Takt ordered me to stop right then and there. Rival! If you’re going to go and mess this up on your own, I’ll take you on!
“Huh? Are you an idiot?　Threatening people by tying an egg to yourself? Take a good, objective look at yourself right now. You look way too pathetic. You’re so lame, so pathetic—pupupu!”
“Ugh… t-that’s exactly your weak spot, isn’t it!”
“That’s why I’m not going to put up with this stupid, annoying blackmail anymore.”
While weaving magic, Rival fixed me with a gaze that radiated an incredibly intense sense of intimidation.
“With Naofumi, the Spear Hero, around, I think the chances of Takt winning are practically zero… but even if you do win, think about what will happen… and brace yourself.”
“W-what do you mean?”

“Takt will undoubtedly sway public opinion to eradicate the Filolials—the creatures you loved. When that happens, even if the Queen of the Filolials intervenes, she won’t be able to stop the tide of human society.”
I suppose Takt and his group intend to win through information warfare. It’s beyond baffling that they think they can turn the tide when their own misdeeds have spread this widely.

But I suppose they truly believe they can do it. In any era, there are always those who’ll side with the winner… It’s lamentable, really. I recall Father from the first world lamenting that very point as well.

“The victor is always right. Evil Filolials are rampaging all over the world. The truth will be hidden, and if we are defeated, the evil Filolials will be eradicated… The smear campaign portraying Filolials as evil creatures will continue unabated.”
Rival and Father speak of a horrifying future. It felt as if every pore in my body—not just my spine—was opening wide.
“If that happens, the Filolials will inevitably face extinction before long.”
“Of course. The very existence of the creatures you love makes me want to vomit! They were disgusting. Every single one of those Filolials was raised in such a weird way!”
“Boo!”
“Kou and the others aren’t weird!”
“To blame your own shortcomings on others… what a petty mindset you have.”
Sakura-chan and Kou raise their voices in protest, while Yuki-chan lets out a sigh of exasperation.
“The reason the Filolial-sama aren’t noble is because you’re not a true hero! I’ll never forgive you for turning the Filolial-sama into what they’ve become!”

“Save your nonsense for when you’re asleep! They’re disgusting creatures either way. I raised you for this plan, but seriously… you’re working so hard even though I’m going to kill all of you later—you’ve got to be kidding me.”
Takt… you’ve just trampled on the trust that Filolial-sama placed in you! I never imagined her anger could reach such a limit.
Uncontrollable feelings of curse are crackling and surging from my spear. X is nothing compared to this. I’ve already reached the point where I can’t think about the consequences anymore…
“Motoyasu-kun…”

Father, who’s tending to the Queen’s wounds, takes my hand. That’s right… Just as Filo-tan saved me back then, and just as Big Sister saved Father when he was about to be consumed by rage after being eroded by the Curse Shield, Father in this loop… is trying to hold me back. But… I’ve reached my limit.
“Spear Hero! Listen to me before you’re consumed by rage!”
Rival shouted at me right then.
“Weigh the extinction of the Filolials against the unborn Filolials right before your eyes and the pitiful, raised Filolials—think about what’s truly important!”
“B-but…!”
My hands are still shaking. That’s right! It’s highly likely that everything Rival said is just a false possibility of the future.

After all, right now, the Filolial-samas are working hard to minimize the damage, and even the great Filolial-samas are doing their best. What do you mean, “eradication of the Filolial-samas”? The Filolial-samas are immortal!

“…As the Dragon Emperor and the King of Monsters, I, Gaelion, the Spear Hero, cannot overlook the unjust persecution of the Filolials currently alive due to Takt’s outrageous actions. That is precisely why I can kill Gaelion later—as many times as I want. So… for now, just keep quiet and tend to the Queen’s wounds.”

……Rival’s gaze held something that struck a chord within me. I could sense no falsehood in his feelings. For Filolial-sama’s sake… Rival was willing to defile himself and bear the guilt… I could feel that resolve.
“Oink!?”

Right then, Yuki-chan—having transformed into Filolial-sama—delivered a roundhouse kick to the charging pig. The impact caused several eggs wrapped around the pig’s body to shatter! It’s Yuki-chan!? That’s right!

“…While I am extremely dissatisfied, I agree with the Dragon’s argument and offer my respect. Lord Motoyasu, I’m sorry, but I’ve decided that Yuki will also be punished! You may scold me as much as you like later… I will atone with my life.”
Ugh… Yuki-chan!　What on earth are you saying!? But… ugh… there’s some truth to what Rival and Yuki-chan are saying, too. Kuuuuuuu….
“I’m sorry, but I can’t just make the representative of Shieldfreeden and Filolial, the leader of the Spear Heroes, take all the blame.”
“Yes.”
“You’ll pay for your past misdeeds with your very life!”
“Don’t get too cocky, you idiot! Dieeeeeee!”
Takt swings his sword and lunges at Zou, who was leading the charge. However, as Zou planted his foot firmly, a vibration radiated out from him, and with a thud, Takt was sent flying.
“What!? Whoa! But this is nothing!”
Zou grabbed a desk that happened to be lying nearby and hurled it at Takt. With a whoosh, Takt was blown away.
“Oink!?”
The pigs were caught up in the blast and blown away as well.
“Here we go!”

With Takt now isolated, Zou launched a preemptive strike, followed immediately by Panda, who leaped through the air like a dance, using the desk as a foothold to slash at Takt with his claws. With a sharp “Zash,” its claws cleanly sliced into Takt, who was poised in midair.
“Hmm…”
Seizing the momentum, Éclair glided around and unleashed a rapid-fire series of sharp thrusts with her dagger at Takt in midair, sending him flying back into the air once more.
